crossRefs.note: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”
translations.bsb: “Whom shall I bring up for you?” the woman asked. “Bring up Samuel,” he replied.
translations.kjv: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
translations.asv: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
